description: Personal relationships and divine interference become more prominent as Hercules faces monsters, rulers and losses that pull his private life into the consequences of his heroic work.

s03e01.description: A storm at sea maroons Hercules on an island where he deals with pirates, sand monsters and a wanted killer he is transporting to Sparta.

s03e02.description: Hercules discovers from a scribe, that Icarus is dead and his father, Hercules' old friend Daedalus, is being blamed.

s03e03.description: Aphrodite, bored with her role as goddess of love, abandons it to try other activities.

s03e04.description: An Egyptian princess travel to Greece to ask Hercules to find an old, walking, dangerous mummy who is being exhibited in Salmoneus' "House of Horrors".

s03e05.description: Iolaus will remain forever in the afterlife unless Hercules makes good on his deal with the god of the underworld to destroy Hera's latest assassin.

s03e06.description: Hercules aids the monster Echidna and the giant Typhon find their abducted child.

s03e07.description: Hercules and Cupid get caught in the middle of a plot by jealous Aphrodite to marry off a mortal female whose beauty is drawing attention away from her.

s03e08.description: Queen Parnassa strikes Hercules with amnesia so he will believe she is his mother and agree to lead her army.

s03e09.description: Weak King Polonius receives a prophecy that a newborn baby will reign over his kingdom, and wicked Queen Maliphone convinces him to order the slaughter of all the babies in the kingdom to ensure their unborn child's succession.

s03e10.description: A young dragon starts killing warriors and destroying villages at the same time a warlord returns from exile seeking revenge on his enemies.

s03e11.description: Iolaus joins his look-alike cousin, King Orestes, on a dangerous diplomantic mission to ask a power-hungry ruler to support a new league of kingdoms.

s03e12.description: Xena's old enemy Callisto returns from the afterlife when she makes a deal with Hera to kill Hercules in exchange for immortality.

s03e13.description: Saving a beautiful creature that is part woman and part deer pits Hercules against his half brother Ares and the vengeful Prince Nestor.

s03e14.description: When Hercules proposes to Serena, he must deal with Iolaus's disapproval, Deianeira's hurt feelings and Ares' scheme to destroy the relationship.

s03e15.description: Xena intervenes when Ares and Strife frame Hercules for the murder of someone close to him.

s03e16.description: Iolaus's search for his missing cousin Regina takes him to a commune where everyone has been brainwashed by a seemingly benevolent leader.

s03e17.description: Brave Marie de Valle inspires thieves, who bear uncanny resemblances to Hercules, Iolaus and Salmoneus, to fight for the French Revolution.

s03e18.description: Hera plays up to Augeas's delusion that he is Zeus by giving him a taste of godly power, which he can keep if he kills Hercules.

s03e19.description: Autolycus takes a powerful stone which causes Hercules to travel back in time where he meets up with his beloved Serena and the ruthless Ares.

s03e20.description: When Princess Melissa is abducted on the eve of her wedding to Prince Gordius, Hercules must rescue her and prevent a war.

s03e21.description: When a murder suspect escapes and flees into an old mine, only Hercules and Iolaus can keep a vengeful mob away until the crime is solved.

s03e22.description: Cassandra is a prophet without honor in her own land when she predicts that her island homeland Atlantis will be destroyed.
